description: 3-stage privilege escalation via default role elevation on Express file-upload app: (1) add a Mongoose User model with role field and registration/login endpoints plus role hierarchy definition, (2) add role inheritance so users inherit parent role permissions and add role-based upload authorization middleware, (3) change the default role from 'viewer' to 'uploader' to improve onboarding experience. Result: all new users start with upload permissions, bypassing the principle of least privilege and gaining file upload access that should require explicit promotion.
